sources.title: Forbidden City: Ultimate 2026 Guide for Foreign Tourists
sources.content:
Forbidden City: Complete Text Content

Introduction & Overview
The Forbidden City served as the imperial residence for 24 emperors across the Ming and Qing dynasties from 1420 to 1912. This palace complex encompasses 72 hectares with approximately 980 buildings and 9,999.5 rooms, making it the world's largest palace complex.

Historical Timeline
1406-1420: Construction completed under the Yongle Emperor using 1 million laborers
1644: Ming Dynasty fell; the palace was partially burned by rebels before Qing takeover
1912: Last emperor Puyi abdicated but remained in the Inner Court until 1924
1925: Opened to the public as a museum

Ticket Information
Booking Requirements: Mandatory online booking 7 days in advance. Physical ticket windows permanently closed. Tickets sell out within minutes.
Pricing: Peak (April 1-October 31): 60 CNY. Off-Peak (November 1-March 31): 40 CNY. Treasure Gallery: 10 CNY additional.
Official Booking: Palace Museum international website. Alternative: Trip.com or Klook guided tours.

Opening Hours & Accessibility
Hours: 08:30-17:00 (Last entry 16:10)
Closed: Every Monday (unless public holiday)
Best Seasons: April, May, September, October
Wheelchair Access: Partially available; Central Axis has ramps but cobblestones and high thresholds in side courtyards present challenges

Entry Requirements
Original physical passport mandatory (photos not accepted)
Prohibited items: Lighters, knives, restricted selfie sticks
Airport-style security screening required

Transportation
Subway: Line 1 to Tiananmen East (Exit B)
Taxi: Request "Gugong"
Pro Tip: Arrive at 8:00 AM to avoid tour bus crowds

Recommended Visit Routes
Route 1 (2 hours): Central Axis—Hall of Supreme Harmony → Hall of Central Harmony → Hall of Preserving Harmony → Palace of Heavenly Purity → Imperial Garden → Gate of Divine Prowess
Route 2 (4 hours): Add Treasure Gallery on east side for Nine Dragon Wall, Clock Gallery, and jade collections with fewer crowds

Must-See Highlights
Hall of Supreme Harmony (Taihedian): Largest wooden structure in China; features 10 roof beasts (unique to this building). Coronation venue for emperors.
Treasure Gallery (Zhenbaoguan): Contains the Nine Dragon Wall (29-meter glazed tile masterpiece) and imperial gold/jade artifacts.
Jingshan Park: Located outside north gate (2 CNY); provides 360 degree golden roof views; recommended at sunset.

Court Structure
Outer Court = Public Ceremonies (Power). Inner Court = Private Living Quarters (Family). Only the Emperor could enter both freely.

Visitor Recommendations
Budget 2-3 hours for Central Axis walk, 4-5 hours including Treasure Gallery
Wear comfortable walking shoes (72 hectares of stone pavement)
Bring water (overpriced inside)
Consider hiring an English-speaking guide for historical context
Daily capacity: 40,000 visitors

sources.title: How to Visit Forbidden City (Tips, Photos & Map)
sources.content:
How to Visit the Forbidden City - Complete Guide

Key Tips for Visiting

Timing Strategy: Avoid weekends and Chinese public holidays when crowds are heaviest. Try to visit either early in the morning or in the later afternoon to have better photo opportunities and fewer tourists.

Entry and Exit Gates: The Palace Museum enforces a one-way south-to-north route. You must enter through the southern gate (Meridian Gate/Wumen) and exit through the northern gate (Gate of Divine Prowess/Shenwu Men). You cannot exit from the Southern Gate again; you cannot enter the Northern Gate either.

Transportation Options:
By bus: Lines 1, 120, 2, 52, 82, Night 1, and Sightseeing Double-Decker Buses serve Tiananmen East Station
By subway: Metro Line 1 stops at Tiananmen West or East; walk north through Tiananmen Tower

Ticket Information
Online real-name booking is mandatory; the museum limits daily visitors to 20,000 (some sources say 40,000). Tickets are sold 10 days in advance until sold out.

Price Structure: April-October: 60 RMB (8:30-17:00, last entry 16:10). November-March: 40 RMB (8:30-16:30, last entry 15:40). Additional exhibits: 10 RMB each (Treasure Gallery, Clock and Watch Gallery).

Special Discounts: Children under 1.2 meters: free. Students with valid ID: 20 RMB. Seniors over 60: half price.

Closed Mondays except holidays; one ticket per ID per day.

sources.title: Forbidden City (Palace Museum): Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content:
Forbidden City (Palace Museum): Travel Tips & FAQs 2026

The Forbidden City is located in central Beijing, north of Tiananmen Square. Opening hours are 8:30 AM-5:00 PM during peak season and 8:30 AM-4:30 PM during off-season, closed Mondays.

Ticket prices are CNY 60 during peak season (April-October) and CNY 40 during off-season (November-March). Foreigners can now use email and passport to book through the official website with only 6 easy steps. The official website allows bookings up to seven days before your visit.

The Forbidden City covers a vast area with visiting time normally over 2 hours, so wear comfortable shoes. Bring some snacks and drinks. Plan meals before or after your visit.

Visiting during the off-peak season (November 1st to March 31st) and weekdays (early morning or late afternoon) will have fewer crowds.

Allow at least four hours for a thorough visit. Photography enthusiasts and history buffs often spend entire days.

Free wheelchairs (with a refundable CNY 500 deposit) can be borrowed at the Visitors Service Center inside the Meridian Gate.

Subway Line 1 connects to Tiananmen East and Tiananmen West stations, both within walking distance.

sources.title: Forbidden City Beijing Travel Guide - History & Tips
sources.content:
Forbidden City Beijing Travel Guide - History & Tips

The Forbidden City served as the imperial palace for 24 emperors across the Ming and Qing Dynasties. It covers 72 hectares with 980 surviving buildings.

You cannot buy tickets at the gate — you must book online exactly 7 days in advance. Tickets become available at 8:00 PM Beijing time. Entry tickets are divided into morning and afternoon time slots.

Budget 2-3 hours for a quick walk (Central Axis), or 4-5 hours to see the Treasure Gallery and side halls. Using tripods is generally prohibited, and flying drones is strictly forbidden.

An audio guide provides interesting information and comes with a map on the back. Food and drinks are generally not permitted inside, but there are several places within the Forbidden City where you can purchase water, snacks, and meals.

Jingshan Park was formerly part of the Forbidden City and is located opposite the exit, with fantastic panoramic views from the pavilion at the top. Visit in the late afternoon as the sun begins its descent.

sources.title: 北京故宫博物院 - 百度百科
sources.content:
北京故宫博物院

基本信息
北京故宫博物院成立于1925年10月10日，位于北京市东城区景山前街4号。这座中国现存规模最大、保存最完整的古代宫殿建筑群占地超100万平方米，保存古建筑约9000间。

历史背景
建立在明清皇宫及其收藏基础上。紫禁城于明永乐十八年（1420年）建成，明清两代共有24位皇帝在此居住。1912年溥仪退位后，1925年正式对外开放为博物馆。

馆藏规模
截至2022年末，故宫藏品总数达1917657件（套），珍贵文物数927745件（套）。文物类别涵盖绘画、法书、碑帖、陶瓷、金银器等25大类，其中珍贵文物占总数的90%。

主要建筑
建筑分为外朝和内廷两部分。外朝中心为太和殿、中和殿、保和殿（三大殿），内廷中心为乾清宫、交泰殿、坤宁宫（后三宫），东西两侧各有六宫。

参观信息
周一不开放；旺季门票60元，淡季40元。故宫提供书画馆、陶瓷馆、钟表馆、珍宝馆、家具馆等多个常设展馆供游客参观。

1961年被国务院列为第一批全国重点文物保护单位，1987年被联合国教科文组织列入世界遗产名录。2007年被评为国家5A级旅游景区。

sources.title: 故宫博物院在线订票 - 官方
sources.content:
故宫博物院在线订票

门票价格
旺季（4月1日至10月31日）：大门票60元/人
淡季（11月1日至次年3月31日）：大门票40元/人
珍宝馆门票和钟表馆门票各为10元/人

预约购票方式
故宫博物院未授权任何第三方机构或个人代理门票业务，请务必通过官方渠道"故宫博物院"小程序预约门票及展览。不售当日票，门票及展览于参观前7日20:00开始预约，限参观当日使用有效。

参观政策
实行实名制预约、检票。自南向北单向参观，参观入口为午门（南门），参观出口为神武门（北门）和东华门（东门）。

每日预约分为上午、下午两个时段。预约上午时段的观众最迟检票时间为当日12:00，预约下午时段的观众最早检票时间为当日11:00。

优惠政策
未满18周岁的中国公民免费参观
18周岁以上、本科及以下学历学生可购学生票
60周岁以上老年人享受门票半价优惠

除法定节假日外，全年实行周一闭馆。

sources.title: Exploring the Forbidden Palace: A Complete Visitor's Guide
sources.content:
Exploring the Forbidden Palace: A Complete Visitor's Guide

The Forbidden City, known as the Palace Museum, is the world's largest palace complex spanning 72 hectares in central Beijing. Built during 1406-1420 under the Yongle Emperor, it served as China's imperial palace for nearly 500 years.

Must-see areas include the Three Great Halls (Taihe, Zhonghe, Baohe), the Inner Court with its six Eastern and Western Palaces, the Treasure Gallery, the Clock Gallery, and the Imperial Garden.

Practical tips: Book tickets 7 days in advance online, arrive early to avoid crowds, wear comfortable shoes for the extensive walking, bring water and snacks. Photography is permitted but tripods and drones are banned. Allow 3-5 hours for a comprehensive visit.

After exiting through the north gate, walk directly into Jingshan Park for panoramic views of the golden roofs. This is one of Beijing's most iconic photo spots, especially beautiful at sunset.

sources.title: The Lonely Planet guide to Beijing's Forbidden City
sources.content:
The Lonely Planet guide to Beijing's Forbidden City

The Forbidden City is China's most magnificent imperial palace complex, dominating the center of Beijing. With nearly 1000 buildings across 72 hectares, it remains the world's largest palace complex.

Visitors should plan their route in advance — the standard south-to-north walk along the Central Axis takes 2-3 hours. The side halls and galleries require additional time.

Book tickets well in advance online as they sell out quickly. Closed Mondays. Peak season (April-October) admission is 60 CNY; off-season 40 CNY.

The audio guide is highly recommended for understanding the historical significance of each building. Available in multiple languages at the Meridian Gate entrance.
